label: end-of-episode clock (last ~10 trials), D2 and late D1
explanation: Fires only in the final trials of an episode: 99% of activation mass is at ep_trial 90-99, none before trial 80, and it coincides with the value head dropping below ~5.2 (100% of mass). It is essentially silent at GO. Within that late window it fires mainly at D2 (82% of mass) and also at D1 on the very last trials. Activation ramps up trial by trial toward the episode end, so magnitude acts as a time-to-end signal. Magnitude is also higher when S2 / a2 is the reached state or the input (in_state=2 lift 2.9x vs 1.5x for S1). It does not depend on reward, transition type, or stay/switch. Precision is limited because the earliest late trials (about 90-92) are often below threshold. The predicate uses only episode time and phase, which the agent can track by counting; no future variables. A finer variant, (phase == D2) & (ep_trial >= 90) & ((state == 2) | (ep_trial >= 93)) | (phase == D1) & (ep_trial >= 95), reached dev F1 0.76 vs 0.74.
